absent: Locking, RCU, IRQ, sleep and concurrency constraints for operation callbacks and exit records.
Dispatch batch limit value, queue identifiers, enqueue and dequeue and wake flag bit definitions, and slice defaults.
Full operations table tail beyond the truncated group weight hook, including remaining members and size.
Arena address management for enable, mask handling, and processor claim sequencing.
Allocation ownership and lifetime for reason, message, dump and trace buffers in exit records.
Sub scheduler attach ordering, validation failures, and hierarchy interaction beyond handover notes.
Timing guarantees for tick cadence, watchdog thresholds for stall and requeue and rescue faults, and restart semantics.

findings.text: Exit kinds start with SCX_EXIT_NONE for idle and SCX_EXIT_DONE for finished. Teardown uses a higher band beginning at sixty four, where SCX_EXIT_UNREG marks user driven removal while SCX_EXIT_UNREG_BPF marks BPF driven removal and SCX_EXIT_UNREG_KERN marks kernel driven removal. The numeric gap separates quiet states from unload requests.

The teardown band continues with SCX_EXIT_SYSRQ for sysrq trigger plus SCX_EXIT_PARENT for parent exit alongside SCX_EXIT_PARENT_KILL for parent initiated kill. Faults live higher beginning at one thousand twenty four, where SCX_EXIT_ERROR means generic failure while SCX_EXIT_ERROR_BPF means BPF reported failure and SCX_EXIT_ERROR_STALL means watchdog stall plus SCX_EXIT_ERROR_REENQ for requeue excess plus SCX_EXIT_ERROR_RESCUE for rescue overload. Ranges allow classifying voluntary versus fault exits.

Exit codes place cause and follow up in upper bits. One cause bit at position thirty two is SCX_ECODE_RSN_HOTPLUG for hotplug, plus a nearby cause bit SCX_ECODE_RSN_CGROUP_OFFLINE for offline group. A distinct action bit at position forty eight is SCX_ECODE_ACT_RESTART requesting restart. Causes and actions occupy disjoint regions.

One exit flag at bit zero records whether setup completed. SCX_EFLAG_INITIALIZED is set only when init finished, so teardown can tell early load failure where exit runs without init from normal unload with richer state.

Option bits zero through four tune admission paths. Bit zero SCX_OPS_KEEP_BUILTIN_IDLE retains core idle bookkeeping alongside custom hooks. Bit one SCX_OPS_ENQ_LAST forces final runnable tasks through enqueue. Bit two SCX_OPS_ENQ_EXITING lets leaving tasks reach enqueue rather than local bypass. Bit three SCX_OPS_SWITCH_PARTIAL confines attachment to extended policy threads. Bit four SCX_OPS_ENQ_MIGRATION_DISABLED routes pinned threads through enqueue.

Option bits five through eight govern wakeup plus topology plus lookup. Bit five SCX_OPS_ALLOW_QUEUED_WAKEUP opts into direct enqueue on wake CPU without guaranteed placement call. Bit six SCX_OPS_BUILTIN_IDLE_PER_NODE chooses node scoped idle sets over one flat set. Bit seven SCX_OPS_ALWAYS_ENQ_IMMED treats local placements as immediate. Bit eight SCX_OPS_TID_TO_TASK enables identifier to thread lookup, where only root activates it and sub schedulers merely declare dependence.

Aggregation plus reservation finish the option word. SCX_OPS_ALL_FLAGS unions the nine public bits zero through eight. The top byte is fenced off as core private under __SCX_OPS_INTERNAL_MASK, and bit fifty six SCX_OPS_HAS_CPU_PREEMPT advertises preempt callback presence. Public definitions must leave reserved high bits clear.

Preemption causes enumerate four ordered cases. SCX_CPU_PREEMPT_RT covers realtime takeover while SCX_CPU_PREEMPT_DL covers deadline takeover and SCX_CPU_PREEMPT_STOP covers stop takeover, with SCX_CPU_PREEMPT_UNKNOWN as fallback. The value tells why extended scheduling lost the processor.

Exit detail record bundles discriminator plus origin plus diagnostics. Field kind holds the category, field exit_cpu holds a signed processor number where negative signals unknown origin, field exit_code holds a signed code for graceful cases, field flags holds option bits, field reason points at explanatory text, fields bt plus bt_len give trace address plus count for faults, while fields msg plus dump give operator message plus debug blob. The processor field gains meaning once kind is assigned.

Group setup arguments convey weight plus limits plus idle mode. Field weight is unsigned thirty two bit in range one to ten thousand. Fields bw_period_us plus bw_quota_us plus bw_burst_us are sixty four bit microsecond limits. Field sched_idle is boolean reflecting idle configuration.

Dump snapshot holds exit summary plus capture time. Field kind carries category, field exit_code carries signed code, field reason points at text, while fields at_ns plus at_jiffies stamp capture in nanoseconds and ticks. The same snapshot threads through global and per processor and per thread dump hooks.

Task setup arguments separate fork from transition. Field fork is boolean true on fork path and false on scheduler switch path. With group scheduling enabled an added field cgroup points at the group being joined. The record guides one time preparation.
Task teardown arguments carry a single boolean field cancelled that is true when the thread departed before ever running under extended scheduling, letting cleanup skip state that never formed.
Enable arguments currently carry one sixty four bit field cmask_arena_addr giving an arena address. No further enable parameters appear.
Processor claim arguments form an empty record with no fields, kept as a stable placeholder for future extension.

Processor release arguments pair cause with successor. Field reason uses the preemption enumeration, while field task points at the thread about to occupy the processor, letting the outgoing scheduler observe what follows.

Sub scheduler handover arguments share one shape for attach and detach. Field ops points at scheduler operations and field cgroup_path points at a path string naming the subtree changing owner. Attach introduces operations for that path while detach withdraws them.

The operations table is the durable extension contract between core and BPF schedulers. It groups placement plus queueing plus dispatch plus time plus presence plus yield plus ordering plus weight plus affinity plus idle plus task lifecycle plus diagnostics plus group management, with option flags selecting default bypasses.

Wakeup placement receives waking thread plus prior processor plus wake flags and returns a target processor. The hint is advisory and may shift before execution, yet accuracy saves moves. Naming an idle target kicks it for dispatch, and direct queue insertion from this hook skips the later enqueue step. The hook never runs for threads bound to one processor or with migration disabled.

Enqueue delivers a ready thread plus enqueue flags for BPF handling, transferring ownership to BPF when not directly queued, so neglect freezes the thread. Dequeue asks to withdraw a thread for isolation during attribute updates, but may be omitted because core tolerates stray dispatches, at the price of possibly stale order across priority edits. Prior direct insertion suppresses enqueue.

Dispatch refills an empty per processor local queue, taking processor number plus outgoing thread as hint. It may insert from BPF state or relocate from user queues into local storage, limited by a configured maximum insert batch between relocations. When the hint thread spent its slice but stays queued, quiet return prolongs it. Final thread handling follows the matching option.

Periodic tick runs at HZ cadence on processors executing extended threads, passing the current thread. Assigning zero slice to that thread requests an immediate dispatch cycle, giving a time share preemption point.

Presence moves from runnable through one or more running and stopping pairs to quiescent. Runnable spans wakeup plus cross processor arrival plus restore after temporary withdrawal. Running and stopping bracket execution, then quiescent spans sleep plus departure plus temporary withdrawal for attribute edits. Presence signals are decoupled from queue callbacks so either may appear alone, and running plus stopping may run away from the thread processor, requiring a helper query for true placement.

Yield takes source thread plus optional target. Without target the scheduler should prefer other runnable work before the yielder and the boolean result is ignored. With target the boolean reports whether direct handoff was honored. A distinct ordering predicate compares two runnable threads for core scheduling, returning true when the first must lead, defaulting to runnable time order when unimplemented, with nearest common ancestor deciding cross scheduler pairs in hierarchies.

Weight change delivers thread plus new value in range one to ten thousand. Affinity change delivers thread plus allowed mask. Idle change delivers processor number plus entering versus leaving boolean for true transitions only. Providing idle handling by default disables core idle selection helpers and demands custom placement unless retention is requested. A scheduler with private idle state must heal that state from dispatch when an idle claim yields no thread.

Task lifecycle pairs one time setup with repeated attach cycles. Init runs once per thread on load or fork, may block for allocation, reports fork versus switch in arguments, and negative errno aborts load or that fork. Exit cleans on thread end or unload. Enable runs on each entry to extended scheduling and always mates with a later disable on departure or exit or unload.

Fault introspection offers global plus per processor plus per thread hooks sharing one snapshot. Global reports scheduler wide state, per processor adds processor number plus idle flag and omits silent idle processors, while per thread adds a runnable thread pointer. All emit through the BPF dump facility.

Group handling pairs init with exit plus prepare with commit or cancel. Init runs per group per scheduler on load or creation or handover, may block, and failure aborts load or that creation, while exit runs on unload or destruction. Enabling sub scheduler gains init for its subtree as prior owner sees exit and disabling reverses. Deleted groups remain schedulable until dying threads finish switching, so hooks may target removed groups. Prepare may allocate and failure aborts the move, commit runs while dequeued, cancel undoes preparation, and only non rehoming moves use this trio while rehoming uses task setup plus teardown and endpoints may lie outside the init set when controller granularity is coarser.

Pinned and leaving threads default to local bypass unless opted in. Unhashed leaving threads land directly locally to avoid lookup loss, with identifier lookup as dependable path when enabled. Pinned threads default locally with standard slice and skip placement, while their usable mask narrows to current processor even though allowed count still tracks user setting. Single processor threads likewise skip placement.

Ownership plus wakeup plus idle paths can stall or mislead. BPF owned threads freeze when never forwarded. Reliance on process identifier lookup drops leaving threads. Queued wakeup may present enqueue on wake processor without prior placement, which must be tolerated when enabled. Private idle books misclassify claimed but empty processors unless healed. Skipped dequeue leaves stale order across edits.

Setup failures demand prompt abort and defensive delivery. Negative init or prepare results stop load or creation or migration. Removed groups and cross processor notifier execution mean callbacks may observe deleted objects or run away from the affected processor, so code must not assume local or live context.
